claim.claim-text: 1. A terminal (20) configured to communicate with a base station (10) that uses one or more beams, the terminal comprising:

a receiving section (203) configured to receive a signal including at least one of a synchronization signal and a broadcast channel; and a control section (401) configured to control a reception of a physical downlink control channel, PDCCH, to which downlink control information scrambled by a paging identifier, P-RNTI, is mapped, characterized in that the downlink control information is located within a same symbol as that of the signal, the control section specifies a frequency resource for the DCI that is offset in a frequency direction with respect to a frequency resource of the signal, the control section controls reception of the DCI based on a timing that is determined based on identification information of the terminal, and wherein the control section monitors the DCI in the timing of the terminal, per each cycle of discontinuous reception in an idle state.

2. The terminal (20) according to claim 1, wherein the control section (401) is configured to determine a frequency resource for the downlink control information within a predetermined resource range based on a frequency location of a resource in which the signal is received.
3. The terminal (20) according to claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the control section (401) is configured to control a reception of a paging message located within the same symbol as that of the signal.

4. The terminal (20) according to claim 3, wherein the receiving section (203) is configured to receive, as the paging message, at least one of information to order a change of system information, an Earthquake and Tsunami Warning System, ETWS, and a Commercial Mobile Alert Service, CMAS.
5. A radio communication method for a terminal (20) configured to communicate with a base station (10) that uses one or more beams, the method comprising:

receiving a signal including at least one of a synchronization signal and a broadcast channel; and controlling a reception of a physical downlink control channel, PDCCH, to which downlink control information scrambled by a paging identifier, P-RNTI, is mapped, characterized in that the downlink control information is located within a same symbol as that of the signal, the terminal specifies a frequency resource for the DCI that is offset in a frequency direction with respect to a frequency resource of the signal, the terminal controls reception of the DCI based on a timing that is determined based on identification information of the terminal, and the terminal monitors the DCI in the timing of the terminal, per each cycle of discontinuous reception in an idle state.
6. A base station (10) that uses one or more beams, comprising:

a transmitting section (103) configured to transmit a signal including at least one of a synchronization signal and a broadcast channel; and a control section (301) configured to control a transmission of a physical downlink control channel, PDCCH, to which downlink control information scrambled by a paging identifier, P-RNTI, is mapped, characterized in that the downlink control information is located within a same symbol as that of the signal,

the terminal specifies a frequency resource for the DCI that is offset in a frequency direction with respect to a frequency resource of the signal, the terminal controls reception of the DCI based on a timing that is determined based on identification information of the terminal, and the terminal monitors the DCI in the timing of the terminal, per each cycle of discontinuous reception in an idle state.
7. A system comprising a base station according to claim 6, and a terminal according to any one of claims 1 to 4.
